changes.from:
Drug shortage due to a shortage of tin chloride, a critical component of the cold kit. Sent notification to drug shortage team on 31 Jul 2026, before account was set up. Mitigations: We have implemented conservation measures and have requested sites to split doses where clinically appropriate to reduce product use and extend available inventory. We have also directed our customers toward alternative products.


Additional measures are being evaluated to minimize impact on patient care, including:
Accelerated and conventional validation of alternative supplier (in progress).
Pursuing importation of equivalent kits via the "Exceptional Importation and Sale of Drugs in Response to Drug Shortages" (GUI-0148).
03 Sep 2026 - updated the anticipated end date for shortage to 30 Sep 2026.
02 Oct 2026 - updated anticipated shortage end date to Oct 31st, 2026. Resupply of PYP has been delayed due to ongoing supplier shortages affecting other cold kit products.  Due to increased manufacturing demands on shared production resources, additional time is required to restore PYP inventory levels and resume normal supply
changes.to:
Drug shortage due to a shortage of tin chloride, a critical component of the cold kit. Sent notification to drug shortage team on 31 Jul 2026, before account was set up. Mitigations: We have implemented conservation measures and have requested sites to split doses where clinically appropriate to reduce product use and extend available inventory. We have also directed our customers toward alternative products.


Additional measures are being evaluated to minimize impact on patient care, including:
Accelerated and conventional validation of alternative supplier (in progress).
Pursuing importation of equivalent kits via the "Exceptional Importation and Sale of Drugs in Response to Drug Shortages" (GUI-0148).
03 Sep 2026 - updated the anticipated end date for shortage to 30 Sep 2026.
02 Oct 2026 - updated anticipated shortage end date to Oct 31st, 2026. Resupply of PYP has been delayed due to ongoing supplier shortages affecting other cold kit products.  Due to increased manufacturing demands on shared production resources, additional time is required to restore PYP inventory levels and resume normal supply
Update 06 Nov 2026 - Anticipated shortage end date was updated to 30 Nov 2026 due to increased demand for the Stannous PYP cold kit driven by the ongoing Gluceptate shortage and Ultratag backorder. The Stannous PYP cold kit may be used as an alternative to Gluceptate and Ultratag for cardiac blood pool labeling.
